subject: Civic Education
lesson: Explains the need of public services: 1-Minute Frozen Tableau Drama: Democratic Governance
unique_learning_outcome: Explains the need of public services.
the_entrance: Engage students with a question on local community needs. (5 mins)
post_activity: Record public services observed at home.

activity_options.title: 1-Minute Frozen Tableau Drama: Democratic Governance
activity_options.description: Students use 1-minute frozen tableau drama to explore 'Presents views appreciating the importance of public services of the times.'. Students take civic roles, respond to a shared scenario, and agree on a reasoned decision. Standard class layout (35 students): Desks arranged into 7 teams (7 teams (7 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
activity_options.student_action_summary: Students take civic roles, respond to a shared scenario, and agree on a reasoned decision. Standard class layout (35 students): Desks arranged into 7 teams (7 teams (7 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
activity_options.teacher_facilitation_summary: Organizes all 35 students using 7 teams (7 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer. and monitors progress with outcome-focused prompts and time checks. Circulates across 7 teams, facilitating role execution and formatively checking progress.
activity_options.student_grouping: 7 teams (7 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer.
activity_options.expected_student_output: A short role-based civic decision and its reasons.
activity_options.creative_assessment_preview: Students state one role responsibility and explain how it supported the decision.
activity_options.low_resource_alternative: Use spoken prompts and notebook pages if printed or display materials are unavailable.
